scripts.build:html: mkdir -p dist/js/pages dist/js/vendor && for f in index.html catalogo.html producto.html carrito.html checkout.html pedidos.html consulta.html operadoras.html login.html registro.html recuperar.html 404.html admin.html gestor.html; do sed -e 's|dist/fonts/|fonts/|g' -e 's|dist/volxen.css|volxen.css|g' -e 's|dist/main.min.js|main.min.js|g' "$f" > "dist/$f"; done && cp config.js auth.js volxen-core.js pedido.js cuenta.css gestor.css logo.svg logo-light.svg logo-dark.svg robots.txt sitemap.xml dist/ && cp js/pages/*.js dist/js/pages/ && cp js/vendor/*.js dist/js/vendor/
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run copy:fonts && npm run copy:categories && npm run build:html
scripts.lint:css: npx stylelint volxen.css 2>/dev/null || echo 'stylelint not installed, skipping'
scripts.lint:js: npx eslint js/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'eslint not installed, skipping'
scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js
scripts.predeploy: npm run build && npm run lint
